/interface ethernet switch
set switch1 l3-hw-offloading=no
/interface ethernet switch l3hw-settings
set autorestart=no ipv6-hw=no
/interface bridge
add name=bridge protocol-mode=none vlan-filtering=yes
/interface ethernet
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-1-1 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-2-1 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-1 ] auto-negotiation=no comment=Switch speed=10G-baseSR-LR
set [ find default-name=sfp28-2 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-3 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-4 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-5 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-6 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-7 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-8 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-9 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-10 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-11 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-12 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=ether1 ] comment="Internet provider"
/interface vlan
add interface=bridge name=mgmt vlan-id=10
add interface=bridge name=home vlan-id=20
add interface=bridge name=guests vlan-id=30
/interface bridge port
add bridge=bridge frame-types=admit-only-vlan-tagged interface=sfp28-1
/interface bridge vlan
add bridge=bridge comment=Management tagged="bridge,sfp28-1" vlan-ids=10
add bridge=bridge comment=Home tagged="bridge,sfp28-1" vlan-ids=20
add bridge=bridge comment=Guests tagged="bridge,sfp28-1" vlan-ids=30
/ip address
add address=203.0.113.2/30 comment="Internet provider" interface=ether1
add address=192.168.10.1/24 interface=mgmt
add address=192.168.20.1/24 interface=home
add address=192.168.30.1/24 interface=guests
/ip pool
add name=home ranges=192.168.20.100-192.168.20.200
add name=guests ranges=192.168.30.100-192.168.30.200
/ip dhcp-server
add address-pool=home interface=home name=home
add address-pool=guests interface=guests lease-time=1h name=guests
/ip dhcp-server network
add address=192.168.20.0/24 dns-server=192.168.20.1 gateway=192.168.20.1
add address=192.168.30.0/24 dns-server=192.168.30.1 gateway=192.168.30.1
/ip dns
set allow-remote-requests=yes servers="1.1.1.1,1.0.0.1"
/ip firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=input comment=Ping protocol=icmp
add action=accept chain=input comment=Management src-address=192.168.10.0/24
add action=accept chain=input comment="DNS from home" dst-port=53 in-interface=home protocol=udp
add action=accept chain=input comment="DNS from guests" dst-port=53 in-interface=guests protocol=udp
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=fasttrack-connection chain=forward comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=forward comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=forward comment="Home to the internet" in-interface=home out-interface=ether1
add action=accept chain=forward comment="Guests to the internet" in-interface=guests out-interface=ether1
add action=drop chain=forward comment=Default
/ip firewall nat
add action=masquerade chain=srcnat comment="Share the public address" out-interface=ether1
/ipv6 firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=input comment=Ping protocol=icmpv6
add action=accept chain=input comment="DNS from home" dst-port=53 in-interface=home protocol=udp
add action=accept chain=input comment="DNS from guests" dst-port=53 in-interface=guests protocol=udp
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=accept chain=forward comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=forward comment="Home to the internet" in-interface=home out-interface=ether1
add action=accept chain=forward comment="Guests to the internet" in-interface=guests out-interface=ether1
add action=drop chain=forward comment=Default
/ipv6 firewall nat
add action=masquerade chain=srcnat comment="Share the public address" out-interface=ether1
/ip firewall service-port
set ftp disabled=yes
set tftp disabled=yes
set irc disabled=yes
set h323 disabled=yes
set sip disabled=yes
set pptp disabled=yes
set rtsp disabled=yes
/ip route
add comment="Internet provider" dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 gateway=203.0.113.1
/ip service
set ftp disabled=yes
set ssh address=192.168.10.0/24 disabled=no
set telnet disabled=yes
set www disabled=yes
set www-ssl disabled=yes
set api disabled=yes
set api-ssl disabled=yes
set winbox disabled=yes
set reverse-proxy disabled=yes
/ip ssh
set strong-crypto=yes
/tool mac-server
set allowed-interface-list=none
/tool mac-server mac-winbox
set allowed-interface-list=none
/tool mac-server ping
set enabled=no
/tool bandwidth-server
set enabled=no
/ip neighbor discovery-settings
set discover-interface-list=none protocol=lldp
/snmp
set enabled=no
/snmp community
set [ find default=yes ] addresses=::/0 name=public
/user
add group=full name=operator password="<secret:ROUTER_PASSWORD>"
/ip settings
set send-redirects=no tcp-syncookies=no
/system identity
set name=router
/system clock
set time-zone-autodetect=no time-zone-name=Asia/Jakarta
/system note
set note="" show-at-login=yes
/system ntp client
set enabled=yes
/system ntp server
set enabled=yes
/system ntp client servers
add address=pool.ntp.org
/system logging action
set 1 disk-file-count=2 disk-lines-per-file=1000
/system package update
set channel=stable
/system routerboard settings
set enter-setup-on=delete-key
/ip traffic-flow
set enabled=no
